stops.note: hospitality to travellers was a strict social duty in Norse society, spelled out in the poem Hávamál
replaced the native Old English cognate 'giest', whose soft g-sound would have made it 'yest'
the silent u was added to spelling to show the g stays hard before e
stops.meaning: a person invited to visit or stay

current_meaning: a person invited to visit, stay, or take part
